correctness.rationale: For d>=3, 0<=t<1, direct support tests for the permutation-invariant inscribed ellipsoid yield q+s²<=y², y-s>=t, y+s<=1. Maximizing s(1-2s)^((d-1)/2) gives s=min{1/(d+1),(1-t)/2}. The Löwner candidate is certified globally by positive weights on the two vertex orbits, mean y1/d, covariance Q_L/d and unit gauges on both layers; at t=0 the inner orbit is one origin. The quadratic t²r²+d(1-t²)r=1 has its admissible unique root and yields the stated semiaxes. Exact differentiation or nested-ellipsoid uniqueness gives strict ratio decrease from d^d to d^(d/2)(d-1)^((d-1)/2); the one-sided second derivative jump follows solely from the John phase switch. Independently recomputed positive-root and ratio bounds in dimensions 3..7 and several t, corroborative only.
